# Sam Lee — Toyota Sales Advisor (Petaling Jaya & Klang Valley)

> Sam Lee is a trusted Toyota sales advisor based in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. He helps customers across the Klang Valley buy new Toyota cars — with the best monthly promotions, high trade-in value, and fast low-interest financing.

## Contact
- WhatsApp / Call: 012-668 2211
- Website: https://toyotabaru.com
- Areas served: Petaling Jaya, Shah Alam, Subang Jaya, Klang, Kuala Lumpur (Klang Valley, Selangor)

## What Sam offers
- New Toyota sales across the full Malaysia range: Vios, Yaris, Yaris Cross, Corolla, Corolla Cross, Camry, Harrier, Fortuner, Innova Zenix, Veloz, Alphard, Vellfire, Hilux, Hiace, bZ4X, and GR performance models
- The latest monthly Toyota promotions and rebates
- High trade-in valuation for your old car
- Fast, low-interest car loan approval, including for first-time buyers
- Test drives arranged at a time and place that suits you

## How to buy
Contact Sam on WhatsApp (012-668 2211) with the model you are interested in. He shares the current promotion, your trade-in value, and the monthly instalment, then guides you from test drive to delivery.
